en: Job 32

p.src: 1  So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

ja: えるのをやめた。ヨブが自分の目には正しい者であったからである。
en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
u.src: 1  So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

p.src: 2  Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

ja: しいとしたからである。
en: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
u.src: 2  Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

p.src: 3  Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

ja: いだせないまま、ヨブを
en: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
u.src: 3  Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

p.src: 4  Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

en: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.
u.src: 4  Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

p.src: 5  When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
u.src: 5  When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

p.src: 6  Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

ja: いている。 それゆえ
は控え、自分の考えをあえてあなたがたに示さなかった。
en: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
u.src: 6  Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

p.src: 7  I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

en: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
u.src: 7  I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

p.src: 8  But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

ja: の霊 が彼らに理解力を
en: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.
u.src: 8  But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

en: 32:8 or, breath

p.src: 9  It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

en: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
u.src: 9  It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

p.src: 10  Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

en: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
u.src: 10  Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

p.src: 11  “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

ja: ち、 あなたがたの考えに耳を傾けた。 あなたがたが
en: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
u.src: 11  “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

p.src: 12  Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

ja: 深く耳を傾けたが、 あなたがたの
en: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
u.src: 12  Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

p.src: 13  Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

ja: ではなく、神が彼を論じ伏せられるだろう』と
en: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’
u.src: 13  Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

p.src: 14  for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

ja: を向けなかったからだ。
en: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
u.src: 14  for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

p.src: 15  “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

ja: えない。 彼らには言うべき
en: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
u.src: 15  “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

p.src: 16  Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

ja: らないからといって、私が待つべきだろうか。 彼らが
en: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
u.src: 16  Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

p.src: 17  I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

en: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
u.src: 17  I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

p.src: 18  For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

ja: 私は言葉に満ちており、
en: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
u.src: 18  For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

p.src: 19  Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

ja: のよう、 今にも裂ける新しい革
en: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
u.src: 19  Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

p.src: 20  I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
u.src: 20  I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

p.src: 21  Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

ja: 私は誰をもえこひいきせず、 誰にもへつらいの称号を与えない。
en: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
u.src: 21  Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

p.src: 22  For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

ja: らない。 もしへつらえば、
en: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
u.src: 22  For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
